short_bio: Television writer and producer, creator of Grey’s Anatomy and founder of Shondaland.
biography:
Shonda Rhimes was born in Chicago, studied at Dartmouth College and then film at the University of Southern California. She co-wrote the film Crossroads (2002) and The Princess Diaries 2 (2004).

She created Grey’s Anatomy for ABC in 2005 and spin-off series Private Practice followed in 2007. Scandal (2012) and, as producer, How to Get Away with Murder (2014) formed the Thursday night lineup she called TGIT.

Her company Shondaland moved to Netflix under a 2017 deal, and its series Bridgerton premiered in 2020.
